purpose: Roadmap item 5: solve-wide cooperative resource contract and defensible IR-20/21 envelope
worktree: Uncommitted shared working tree; results describe this state rather than HEAD.

results.worker_kill_demo: SIGKILL observed; no result file emitted by killed solve; rerun completed with ResourceLimit

allocation_injection.assertions: at least one allocation_failure resource_limit per engine; no infeasible or unbounded model claim on injected failure

api_contract.total_time_limit_seconds: Optional solve-wide wall-clock limit measured from API entry; finite and in (0, 1e8]; earliest active deadline wins.
api_contract.memory_limit_bytes: Optional positive byte admission budget; no hard process RSS cap.
api_contract.stop_reason: First cooperative stop from the shared SolveContext; empty when no stop is recorded; unverified optimal, infeasible, and unbounded claims are downgraded to resource_limit.
api_contract.exception_boundary: std::bad_alloc and std::length_error map to resource_limit; worker exceptions stop the parallel queue and report resource_limit; no injected exception escapes solve_file or solve_model.

envelope.deadline: Before engine dispatch and after engine return
envelope.budget: One shared SolveContext owns charged bytes; model input itself is caller-owned.

envelope.stage: LP canonicalize, presolve, scaling, dense conversion, solve, postsolve, verify
envelope.deadline: Stage boundaries plus engine-local checks; sparse, reference, primal, and linear verifiers poll inside loops
envelope.budget: Working-model copy and dense conversion preflight estimates.

envelope.deadline: Stage boundaries and QP engine deadline; verification checked at return
envelope.budget: No comprehensive QP kernel allocation metering.

envelope.deadline: Stage boundary, engine deadline, and primal/linear verifier loops

envelope.stage: MILP and parallel search, verify, certify
envelope.deadline: Stage boundaries, search-engine deadline, and primal verifier loops
envelope.budget: Parallel root-model copy and two BranchNode records per queue child push; dynamic node payloads omitted.

envelope.deadline: Stage boundaries and engine deadlines; callback and verifier bodies are indivisible
envelope.budget: No callback or nonlinear-factor workspace accounting.

envelope.deadline: Shared deadline intersects proof-local deadline; checked between stages
envelope.budget: Coarse proof-build reservation; proof internals are not individually metered.

limitations: Deadline checks are cooperative. Root relaxations, factorization kernels, callbacks, PDLP inner kernels, and individual verifier matrix kernels are not preemptible; runtime can overrun by one such operation.
The four owned verifiers check the optional deadline at iteration or node boundaries, generally every 1024 entries; a single factor or matrix kernel is indivisible.
memory_limit_bytes meters only instrumented charges, not every glibc or third-party allocation. It cannot promise an RSS ceiling or suppress host OOM.
The transient peak_rss_kib=1013492 (~990 MiB) observation in evidence/ir19-w01-memory-20260928.json remains unexplained and is bounded here only if it crosses an instrumented charge point.
SIGKILL discards in-memory state. Checkpointed incumbents are a follow-up, outside this item.
IR-20 and IR-21 remain OPEN pending independent review of this bounded envelope.
